question: A thin wire is bent into a quarter-circular arc of radius $R$ and is located in the first quadrant of the x-y plane, with its center at the origin. The wire has a non-uniform linear charge density given by $λ(θ) = λ₀cos(θ)$, where $λ₀$ is a positive constant and $θ$ is the angle measured from the positive x-axis. A point charge $-Q$ is placed at the origin (0,0). What is the magnitude of the net electrostatic force experienced by the charge $-Q$?
